title: awareness-frame — case shape (v0.2)
description: Pins the magic-less, sync-wire-only live-collaboration awareness frame (protocol/src/awareness_frame.rs; protocol.md §5.2/§10.7; decisions/sync/0655; epic live-collab). A frame is a cleartext header room_id(16) || nonce(24) || version(1 = 0x01), then an XChaCha20-Poly1305 + CTX seal over a canonical-JSON payload, with AAD aad_awareness_frame (role 'awareness-frame' || account_number_hash || optional 8-byte big-endian group_key_epoch for NTV6). Two case kinds: 'frame' (seal and open) and 'assertion_message' (the presence-assertion class prefix and message assembly).

vector_id.description: Stable identifier of the form 'awareness-frame/v0.2/<slug>'. Immutable once shipped.

room_id_hex.description: 16-byte per-note awareness room id (the cleartext routing key).

nonce_hex.description: 24-byte XChaCha20 nonce, in the cleartext header.

group_key_epoch.description: Optional NTV6 group-key epoch, appended to the AAD after the account hash. Absent for an NTV5 vault.

expected_frame_hex.description: The full sealed frame bytes (header || ciphertext || CTX tag), hex. Byte-exact.

open_room_id_hex.description: The room id used for the OPEN call (equal to room_id_hex for a round trip; a different value pins the wrong-room refusal).

open_group_key_epoch.description: Optional epoch used for the OPEN call (a different value pins the stale-epoch refusal).

tamper_last_byte.description: When true the runner flips the last CTX-tag byte before opening, pinning the tampered-tag refusal.

expect_open_ok.description: True when the open must succeed and return the pinned payload; false when it must fail closed (one non-distinguishing CannotDecrypt).

actor_id_hex.description: 16-byte Automerge device actor id bound by the assertion.

person_id_hex.description: 32-byte person id (the person fingerprint) bound by the assertion.

expected_message_hex.description: The exact signed message bytes: 'myne.awareness-presence v1|' || actor_id || person_id, hex. The class prefix inside it is what makes a head signature unverifiable as an assertion.
